completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. chapter_status_scope: Each chapters entry is one original source section; completed_chapters aggregates all source sections carrying the same native chapter number.

original_book_metadata.source_status: Old Greek Daniel in Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.

Daniel 6 likewise gives the two men who testified against Daniel to the lions, additionally naming their wives and children and crushed bones; the target unit does not itself repeat Daniel's removal.

target_verses.text: Then those two men who had testified against Daniel, with their wives and children, were thrown to the lions. The lions killed them and crushed their bones.
target_verses.display_text: Then those two men who had testified against Daniel, with their wives and children, were thrown to the lions. The lions killed them and crushed their bones.
